name: APOLLO 17 — Taurus-Littrow valley

meta.citation: NASA LRO LOLA + JAXA Kaguya TC merged DEM, 512 ppd (~59 m/px)
meta.grid: azimuthal equidistant about the site, resampled bilinear, long axis on bearing 169 deg
meta.resolution_note: source product is 59.225 m/px; this 1024x512 grid at 4 m/px spans 69 x 35 source posts and is a 15x bilinear resampling of them — interpolation, not added detail
meta.layout: row-major, +x along the traverse, +y to its left
meta.note: The last walk, and the longest. A deep valley between massifs, with the light-mantle avalanche deposit on its floor.

blurb: The last walk, and the longest: a valley deeper than the Grand Canyon, between massifs. This is the mission with the most film of crews falling over and getting up again.
